name: Tracking Ritual
summary: Candles, a heart and a name: find anyone on the map.

components.note: you may place up to 5, but 3 trigger it

setup: Place three candles in a triangle.
Hold the heart and click the ground inside the candles, so the heart sits in the middle.
Say the incantation with the player's username.
effect: Tracks and spies on the named player.
